opportunities.name: Hotel search, currency conversion, and email draft to colleague
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a hotel in a city for given dates, convert the price from EUR to a target currency on Xe, then draft a mail proposing the hotel to a recipient.
steps: On Booking.com enter the destination, select check-in and check-out dates, and click Search
Open the top or chosen hotel and note its name and price in EUR
On Xe Currency Converter enter the EUR amount as the receiving amount and pick the target currency
In mail compose a new message: To recipient, Subject 'Hotel for <city>, <dates>'
Body: 'Hi <name>, proposed hotel: <hotel>, <EUR> EUR (about <converted> <currency>). OK to book?'

Milan, Dec 1-4, BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti, 264 EUR -> JPY, kenji@example.com

opportunities.name: City weather forecast and news headline email
opportunities.description: Look up a city's 10-day weather forecast, search BBC for '<city> strike' and open the top article, then email a heads-up with weather and headline to a recipient.
steps: On the weather site open the location search, type the city, select the result, and open the 10 Day tab
Note the forecast for the target day
On BBC open menu search and search '<city> strike'
Open the top article and note headline and date
In mail compose a message to the recipient with subject 'Heads-up: <city> on <day>'

opportunities.name: Visa requirements and holidays research note
opportunities.description: Look up visa requirements for a nationality on Wikipedia, look up the destination country's holidays on timeanddate, and save a summary note in Notes.
steps: On Wikipedia search 'Visa requirements for <nationality> citizens' and open the article
Find the entry for the destination country
On timeanddate open Holidays and open the destination country page
Read holidays for the relevant month
In Notes add '<Nationality> traveler to <country>: <visa status>, allowed stay <x>. Holidays in <month>: <list>' and press Enter
